versions.changelog:
Initial release of WhatsApp Business AI Assistant

- Automates replies, bookings, lead capture, and follow-ups for local service-based businesses.
- Intent classification and response generation using configurable NLP and templates.
- Built-in commands for status, lead export, analytics, and broadcast messaging.
- Integrates with Google Calendar, CRM webhooks, Slack notifications, and payment gateways.
- Customizable reply/follow-up templates and business-specific workflow configurations.
- Simple installation and environment setup for fast deployment.
